description: Add or remove a static DNS entry, found by name (case-insensitive) and type. add returns already_exists if such a record already has the requested value and disabled state (and ttl/comment, when given), and throws CONFLICT if it differs; add never creates a second record with the same name and type. remove deletes the one matching record; when several share the name (round-robin), pass address/cname/text to pick one.

address.description: IP address (required for A records; on remove, picks the record when several share the name)

cname.description: Target hostname (required for CNAME records; on remove, picks the record when several share the name)

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

disabled.description: Whether the entry should be disabled

name.description: Hostname for the DNS record (e.g. server.example.com); matched case-insensitively

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

text.description: Text value (required for TXT records; on remove, picks the record when several share the name)

name: manage_dns_entry
title: Manage DNS Entry
